title: Time-multiplexed 2-digit 7-segment display driver
problemDescription: Time-multiplexed 2-digit 7-segment display. On each rising CLK alternates between SEG_SEL=0001 (showing low nibble of DATA_IN) and SEG_SEL=0010 (showing high nibble). SEG_OUT is the active-low common-anode encoding of the chosen nibble.
